issue_context.title: replace ioutils.ReadAll with io.Copy in TSDB/fileutile.go/copyfile
issue_context.body:
**Use case. Why is this important?**
in TSDB/fileutile.go/copyfile, which use ioutils.Readall read data from disk to user space and then use ioutils.WriteAll write data from user space to disk.
I think it is not efficient.

And in linux copyFileRange in go, which `performs an in-kernel copy between
       two file descriptors without the additional cost of transferring data
       from the kernel to user space and then back into the kernel.`.

And in go, io.Copy implement copyFileRange.
*“Nice to have” is not a good use case. :)*
